description: This file contains bash functions related to Fortinet firmware upgrade process, including functions for handling firmware info blocks and performing the upgrade by extracting firmware components from a tar archive and writing them to device memory partitions.

methods.name: fortinet_fwinfo_blocks
methods.description: Prepares firmware info blocks by writing the block count as a binary pattern to a specific memory device based on an offset and length.

methods.name: fortinet_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by extracting kernel and root filesystem components from a given archive, calculating their sizes, updating firmware info blocks, and writing these components to device memory.
